scope_statement: The major condition families named and oriented.

claims_needing_verification: Knee presentations group by mechanism more usefully than by structure.
Haemarthrosis within hours implies bleeding and a significant structural injury.
True locking implies a mechanical block. Giving way implies instability or inhibition.
Age materially shifts the differential diagnosis.
Septic arthritis must be excluded in any hot swollen knee with systemic upset.
claims_note: Listed above are the substantive claims, taken from the deepest tier's key learning points. Every factual statement in the page body requires the same verification; these are the ones a reviewer should start with.
gaps_or_uncertainties: No quantitative figure is given anywhere on this page unless it is a definitional range, because none could be verified.
